editorial:
If you like weird, playful comedies with a fantasy twist, this one grabs your attention fast. Mitsuki and Yuya are new stepsiblings who barely know how to talk to each other, and their awkward home life gets even stranger when Mitsuki is possessed by Hiyori, a spirit with a crush on Yuya. The story mixes family drama, silly romance, and supernatural rules, so it never feels like a normal teen comedy. It is bold, a little silly, and clearly made for viewers who enjoy over-the-top situations.

The acting keeps the energy high, and the pacing moves quickly from one awkward moment to the next. The comedy lands best if you enjoy goofy fantasy setups, though some jokes may feel too strange or fanservice-heavy for casual viewers. The emotional side works better than expected, especially when Mitsuki and Yuya start to understand each other. If you want something light and unusual, give it a try. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mitsuki and Yuya finally work together to help Hiyori find peace. Hiyori's feelings are revealed, the strange chastity belt situation is resolved, and Mitsuki is freed from the possession. Hiyori moves on to heaven, while Mitsuki and Yuya leave with a stronger, more honest stepsibling bond. The ending keeps the comedy but adds a sweet, emotional goodbye.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky fantasy comedies with awkward romance.
